title: FM27 Skins — First Preview Releases & Installation Checks
description: FM27 skins checked 30 October 2026: Priisek Retro 27 and Super League Turkey, author installation notes, bundle backups and platform caveats.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026 · Launch Preview · Released files verified on author pages; not tested in-game by this site.
body:
FM27 skins are available during the Launch Preview. Priisek Retro 27 and Super League Turkey have dated FM27 release pages. Their installation notes describe replacing game assets, so do not assume that dropping an archive into an old skins folder will work.

First FM27 skin releases

SkinAuthor / source dateWhat the source saysBefore installing
Priisek Retro 27Priisek · 29 October 2026Retro base skin, with a steam.rar download and instructions referring to replacement of StandaloneWindows64 assets.Back up that directory and check the author’s current instructions. The retrieved page does not establish macOS or Game Pass support.
Super League Turkey FM27 SkinEmr1907 · updated 30 October 2026Turkish-club designs, with Fenerbahçe and Frankenstein v1.0 variants listed. Instructions describe replacing three UI bundle files.Choose the files for your platform and retain the originals. The instructions contain leftover FM26 wording, so confirm you are changing the FM27 installation.

We read these release pages on 30 October 2026. Neither retrieved page identifies a numeric FM27 game patch; the first page also has no numeric skin version. Listing a release confirms that the author has published it, not that this site has installed or tested it. There is no performance or “best skin” ranking here.

Bundle replacements are different from a skins folder

The Super League Turkey author identifies three files: ui-mainmenu-assets_assets_all.bundle, ui-styles_assets_default.bundle and ui-tactics_assets_all.bundle. The Windows Steam example ends in Football Manager 27/fm_Data/StreamingAssets/aa/StandaloneWindows64/; the macOS Steam example ends in Football Manager 27/fm.app/Contents/Resources/Data/StreamingAssets/aa/StandaloneOSX/.

Those are the author’s examples and can vary with your installation. Do not copy a Windows bundle into the macOS directory, and do not follow a generic skins-folder tutorial when the selected package explicitly replaces bundles.

Install and restore checklist

  1. Read the selected release page. Confirm the edition, platform and current instructions before downloading.
  2. Close FM27. Locate the installation used by your launcher; distinguish it from any FM26 install.
  3. Back up the exact originals. Keep a separate copy outside the game directory, with the game build and backup date.
  4. Apply only that package. Preserve filenames and directory locations. Install one skin at a time rather than merging multiple archives.
  5. Check the screens you use. Open a player profile, the squad screen, tactics and match day; one working main menu is not a complete check.
  6. Restore if necessary. Close the game and replace the changed files with your matching backup. After a game patch, read the author’s update before reapplying an older bundle.

Can an FM26 skin be used in FM27?

Only if the author explicitly provides an FM27-compatible release or instructions for your build. A logo or facepack compatibility notice does not prove that interface bundles work. Sortitoutsi reports that some older graphics packs work with FM27, but skins change interface assets and need their own compatibility check.

What to check during the Preview

Record the game build, skin release or file version, platform and date installed. Preview updates can replace game assets. An author’s release on 29 or 30 October does not establish support for the 10 November full-launch build, so recheck before carrying the same package forward.
